what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Somalia in Türkiye: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2018, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 3536 Somali asylum seekers in Türkiye, 6.3% of all asylum seekers from Somalia.
Refugees from Somalia, a separate group, live mostly in Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1995 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 2000, at 5 asylum seekers, to 2018.
Its highest and last figure is for 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 and 2018.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Türkiye.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Türkiye only; the data has no figure after 2018.
